description: On the left side of the paper is rectangular stroke of brown, inside this rectangle are brown and green strokes about one third from bottom to middle. From the middle of the paper to the top third of the paper is a light brown block of color. Beginning at the top edge of the light brown a dark blue fades to a lighter blue at the top of the paper.
